name: vim
summary: Tiny-feature Vim editor for the server image, built from the pinned vim/vim release tarball with the tracked vm/commands/vim compatibility configuration, linking only the independent runtime's libSystem.

license.notes: Vim is distributed under the Vim license (charityware), recorded in sources.lock.json as 'Vim license (charityware); see archive runtime/doc/uganda.txt and README.md'. The SPDX license-list identifier is Vim, but this repository's restricted SPDX validator does not include it yet, so SPDX stays null and the archive notices govern.

isolation: The archive SHA-256 is verified against sources.lock.json before and after compilation; the tracked config.h/osdef.h/patch amendments are explicit hashed build inputs. The executable links the independent runtime's libSystem only, never macOS host libraries, and autoconf host probing is not used.

rebuild.note: Pins are validated by scripts/build/packages.py. Guest acceptance of the built editor is recorded in evidence/virtualization/command-tools; a clean-environment rebuild comparison is remaining work.
